prompt: Do I need the receipt to exchange this jacket?
promptZh: 換這件外套需要收據嗎？

options.whyZh: reception 與 receipt 無關，未回應換貨要求。

options.text: A bank statement showing the purchase will also work.
options.zh: 顯示這筆購買的銀行帳單也可以。
options.whyZh: 提供收據的替代購買證明，回應要求。

options.text: The jacket comes in three colors.
options.whyZh: 產品顏色不是換貨所需文件。

explanationZh: 提供收據的替代購買證明，回應要求。
evidence: A bank statement showing the purchase will also work.
